outcome: Transcriptome profiling of rectus abdominis muscle (RAM)
Gene expression related to muscle structure and protein synthesis
Muscle fibers' ability to ameliorate muscle damage
Maintenance and generation of energy through glycogenesis
cohort: The study included women with and without gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and with and without pregnancy-specific urinary incontinence (PSUI) from whom rectus abdominis muscle samples were obtained during Cesarean section.
finding: GDM with PSUI was associated with decreased gene expression related to muscle structure and muscle protein synthesis, reduced ability of muscle fibers to ameliorate muscle damage, and altered maintenance and generation of energy through glycogenesis in the rectus abdominis muscle.
mod_finding: Rectus abdominis muscle samples were obtained during Cesarean section from all participants for transcriptome profiling.
